QUOTE: `BaseDataOperator` is the shared parent. `ServerDataOperatorBase` extends it, and so does `AppDataOperator` (`app/database/operator/app_data_operator/index.ts:15`). Both inherit `batchRecords`, `handleRecords`, `prepareRecords` and `processRecords`, so the app database and the per-server databases share one write path.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names AppDataOperator as the other BaseDataOperator subclass, sharing the same write path for the app database.
